plugins.name: firestorm-avatar
plugins.description: Drive the user's Second Life avatar via the embedded Firestorm MCP server — inventory, appearance, profiles, search, groups, uploads, nearby-avatar inspection, in-world chat + RLV relays. Bundles the three firestorm-* skills and the MCP connection.

plugins.name: mpsearch
plugins.description: Search the Second Life Marketplace — listings, copy/modify/transfer permissions, reviews, creator stores and the category tree. Bundles a dependency-free MCP server, the marketplace-search skill, and a session-capture command.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Reusable role agents — a product owner (shape, guard, cut) and an autonomous senior developer (ship-ready: verified, signed, pushed, PR) — sharing the work-queue handoff protocol so they can be called solo or chained into an autonomous loop.
